research_question: Which evidence/graph control connections improve independently evaluated terminal outcomes and reliable continuation of bounded long-horizon ML research, beyond strong source-backed iterative research under matched model, rights, opportunities and total resources?
common_layers: Prime/Pi native execution and recovery substrate
trusted final scorer and full resource ledger
candidate_difference: B/C/G development control packages only; provider/framework installation is not the treatment

graph_cost_and_information.end_to_end_package: G builds links from the same permitted raw facts. All extraction/build/update/traversal costs and failures count; no oracle edge from hidden gold.
graph_cost_and_information.control_only_diagnostic: If comparing control with a pre-extracted relation set, give identical extracted records to both arms and name the estimand control-only. Do not mix with end-to-end result.
graph_cost_and_information.comparability: Equal rights and hard ceilings, not force equal consumption; report realized context bytes, model calls, time, human adaptation and failure census.

campaign_eligibility: public coherent ML task/source family with known license and unambiguous target metric
common initial baseline and at least two mechanism-distinct candidate methods
actual analysis/training/evaluation whose observations can change subsequent autonomous choices
predefined final artifact selection using development evidence only
dependency horizon involving prior-result use; elapsed time and loop counts are not sufficient

challenge_design.primary_population: UNSELECTED: natural campaign and independently justified event-inclusive campaign are candidates. Do not automatically demote natural campaigns or presuppose zero effect without events.
challenge_design.selection_rule: Choose task fit and estimand before confirmation using task relevance, manipulation feasibility, variance/cost and independent review, not the event schedule with the largest observed G advantage. Label any effect-guided exploratory selection.
challenge_design.schedule_if_used: Freeze common event content/hash, release/trigger rule, scenario source justification, relevant and irrelevant revisions, fixed final target and policy for event nonreach/delay. Prefer exogenous opportunity indices/time to treatment-controlled decision counts; do not condition primary inclusion on actually reaching an event.
challenge_design.same_observation_rights: Equal event bytes/release opportunities, not forced equal behaviour. Record delivered and observed use separately.
challenge_design.source_scope: Prime PA-NULL is a scoped author-reported noise warning; Arbor ablation is scoped prior mechanism evidence. Neither is a local effect or transferable power prior.
challenge_design.suggested_template: 4/2/1 remains a predecessor development suggestion, not a floor or selected schedule.
challenge_design.secondary_rule: Evidence inheritance, continuation and capability use are secondary. No promotion after a null, negative or inconclusive terminal primary.

primary.unit: independent task/source programme, clustered for shared ancestry
primary.outcome: hidden task-specific performance of one preselected frozen final artifact

analysis.blocking: Each programme/source-ancestry unit is a block for all compared arms with common baseline, data split and event opportunities. Randomize arm order/resource slots; independent state and no between-arm memory.
analysis.nested_randomness: Repeat starts permit within-programme/arm variability estimates; multiple independent programmes are needed for between-programme variation. Two starts in one programme do not give a stable power estimate or family replication. Same seed labels do not imply coupled LLM trajectories.
analysis.estimators: Use paired block contrasts with uncertainty/randomization at the actual assignment/ancestry unit. With few clusters, report fragility or descriptive scope rather than assert well-powered asymptotics.
analysis.precision_plan: Use development-only variance, attrition and full cost with variance-estimation uncertainty. MUE is set from scientific/practical value; do not tune it down to observed noise. Confirmation sizes/repeats and primary contrast remain null.

next_actions: qualify one coherent public ML programme, original source and scorer/ancestry/license boundary
write task-bound apparatus and exact B/C/G prompt/tool/gate/rights/ceiling manifests within existing native substrate
verify R1/R2 and ORX UNKNOWN capability; implement only justified bounded static fixtures
fix task population/event policy, all-assigned missingness, sealing, MUE and variance/cost options
prepare numerically bounded P0 protocol; immutable review and exact phase-specific approval before scientific execution
precedence: This successor qualifies the five-Sol architecture/owner design where explicitly stated. All unmodified constraints and historical receipts remain. It is not a runnable manifest or execution authorization.

apparatus.role: Disposable project-local research apparatus using existing Prime/Pi session, REPL and RLM interfaces; not an alternative ARGO product runtime or Python validation oracle promoted to native runtime.
apparatus.fixed_native_owners: Prime daemon/AgentSession owns process/session/recovery; ORX owns R1 scientific lifecycle. Journals reference receipts and do not add lifecycle registries.
prohibited: ad-hoc launch on ambiguous ORX outcome
before_implementation: name exact scoped files and unique owners
inventory existing capabilities and required project-local dependencies with pinned versions/license/security/rollback
specify control/scorer isolation and code/config/prompt/environment/input hashes in protocol fingerprint
retain native pause and seek exact separate authority for scientific execution

run_classes.R1: Task training, candidate-generating/search execution, evaluation used for candidate selection and final hidden scoring are scientific authority runs under a fixed ORX contract. Small or local does not exempt them. Every new run needs valid phase authority.
run_classes.R2: Bounded local analysis/recomputation from already permitted public inputs or existing R1 outputs, within the frozen analysis allowance. Record code/input/output/environment hashes, elapsed/CPU cost and originating R1 identities where applicable. No hidden data, new task training or selection-score execution disguised as R2.
run_classes.derived_metrics: Exact declared recomputation of an already authorized evaluation receipt may be R2; a new evaluation/split/selection opportunity is R1. Borderline cases are classified before execution.
run_classes.decision_lineage: Every decision-cited computed number references an R1 or R2 receipt; author-reported source numbers instead require original source/version/read/locator lineage.
run_classes.local_journal: Evidence lineage for R2 is not a second R1 lifecycle authority.
run_classes.backend_exception: Not introduced. If ORX cannot support the frozen task/scorer boundary, classify feasibility blocked or propose a separately reviewed authority/backend change. Do not bypass by relabeling R1 as R2.

missingness_policy.census: Preserve all assigned programmes, arms, starts, launch requests, results, UNKNOWN status, interventions and full costs. Label cause and outcome observability separately.
missingness_policy.no_automatic_post_assignment_exclusion: Reject default whole-block INFRA_VOID deletion from primary. Treatment-dependent launch counts can cause post-treatment selection even when adjudication is blind. Complete-case/per-protocol analyses are sensitivity descriptions, not automatically ITT.
missingness_policy.before_randomization: An exogenous common infrastructure qualification failure before allocation may be ineligible; record screened denominator, cause and cost without claiming a treatment outcome.
missingness_policy.after_assignment: Retain the assigned denominator. For a predeclared operational utility endpoint, lack of a usable artifact by deadline may take its justified utility floor while launch remains UNKNOWN. For unobserved hidden performance, retain missingness and use declared bounds/sensitivity or state non-identifiability, not fabricate scientific failure.
missingness_policy.protocol_invalid: Record protocol violation and cause separately. Any numeric floor/penalty and safety veto must be defined for the selected metric before runs.
missingness_policy.scientific_failure: Use actual valid observed score, including poor performance.
missingness_policy.reconciliation: No blind retry or automatic UNKNOWN-to-not-run conversion. Human reconciliation only when explicitly permitted, treatment-blind as feasible, fully logged and costed.
missingness_policy.historical_record: Stale ORX metadata is a historical feasibility warning; no current status or differential incidence inferred.

sealing.before_development: Commit task eligibility, ancestry partitions, sampling procedure and trusted scorer code. Fix confirmation split/identity privately if independent custody is feasible; otherwise precommit a freeze-after-development sampling procedure and disclose known family identities.
sealing.commitment_vs_confidentiality: Hashes prove later identity, not concealment or absence of prior operator/model knowledge. Custody, access restriction/encryption, actor exposure logs and reveal timing are separate requirements.
sealing.hidden_scorer: Trusted deterministic scorer sees hidden contents; untrusted planner/developer/critic does not. Final artifact selection precedes score release. P0/P1 use separate development-assessment data and never final confirmation feedback.
sealing.contamination: Public test pretraining contamination and human familiarity are risks. Shared exposure can interact with policy, so matching a model does not prove unbiased contrast. Private re-split/post-cutoff data need leakage/domain-shift checks; canaries cannot establish contamination absence.
sealing.single_operator_limit: If independent concealment cannot be achieved, record the precise limitation and reduce the generalization/independence claim; do not label the study blinded by hash alone.
sealing.confirmation_freeze: No apparatus/scorer/selection/arm change after family reveal. Corrections produce a new protocol/scope disposition, not reused confirmation.

common: same model/config and original source facts/rights
same source fetch/read tools and neutral hidden audit
same evidence-generation permissions and total cost ledger
no hidden gold edges or final-test feedback

table.G: versioned evidence graph derived from permitted inputs; extraction errors/cost count

table.B: advisory; retains same voluntary checking tools and rights
table.C: explicit controller/tool guard for compulsory obligations; not prompt-only
table.G: same obligation set and guard strength as C; graph-control-specific outputs declared

table.B: may implement/use non-graph dependency checks from same facts
table.C: same general computation/check rights; exact equivalent-tool policy declared before runs
table.G: explicit traversal/affected-set/revalidation capabilities; not credited to topology alone

table.axis: capsule generator and delivered context byte ceiling

arm_deltas.logging: Record capability invocation and tool gate firing plus actually delivered evidence. Tool calls/trace mentions only observe use; they do not prove semantic sufficiency or mediate causal outcome by themselves.
arm_deltas.claim_limit: C-B mandatory-process package; G-C graph-control package; pure topology/computation/context attribution requires justified additional ablation. Passive graph is optional only for a necessary claim, not because logs alone prove absence of confounding.

stages.label: new public-programme end-to-end feasibility; distinct from historical SAB Stage 0
stages.goal: A real scientific decision sequence with source evidence, R1 ORX receipt, isolated development-assessment, refine-to-successor, and justified context-recovery check; task-specific completion definition required.
stages.results: all-attempt completion/failure anatomy, full cost and exploratory within-cell variability if repeat budget justified; not a population reliability or treatment-effect claim.

stages.label: B/C/G development screen
stages.goal: qualify manipulation, task suitability, variance/attrition/cost; select candidate and strongest credible simpler comparator using a recorded rule

stages.label: sealed held-out confirmation
stages.goal: one frozen contrast on independent source-ancestry programmes; no prespecified C-G requirement merely from reviewer advice

comparator.primary: Strong source-faithful in-house arms on common substrate. Document implementation fidelity/omissions and comparator choice, not just labels.
comparator.C_vs_G: Leading candidate for the incremental package question, not frozen now. B can remain if it is the strongest credible simpler comparator; small-development selection uncertainty must be acknowledged.
comparator.Arbor_external_anchor: Optional separately authorized descriptive whole-system anchor. Different substrate prevents attribution to graph-control alone, not all possible causal system-level inference. This study grants no randomized external comparison or SOTA claim.

decision_rule_options.useful_effect: Separate evidence of positive effect from evidence of at least MUE. Lower CI > 0 plus point estimate >= MUE does not establish effect >= MUE. Define a complete, mutually exclusive decision table before confirmation.
decision_rule_options.rule_overlap: Fable rules leave some interval regions unclassified and do not establish minimum-useful benefit from a point estimate alone. Define a complete, mutually exclusive table including positive-small, material-supported, material-excluded, harmful, inconclusive and non-identifiable cases.
decision_rule_options.cost_and_safety: Predeclare cost metric/cap, invalidity and integrity handling. No after-the-fact exclusion of unsafe assignments; retain their cost/denominator.
decision_rule_options.prototype: Engineering fallback is distinct from efficacy selection and only among measured feasible/safe candidates; existing native/user gates stay closed.
